cover: Nvidia chief resigns amid scandal while US envoys pursue Ukraine peace talks
cover_scene: A split composition featuring glowing silicon microchips on one side and a grand diplomatic hall with foreign flags on the other under dramatic lightning

slides.scene: A modern glass tech headquarters at dusk with a dark silhouette of an executive walking away, bathed in glowing green circuit lights
slides.headline: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigns over scandal
slides.body: Nvidia co-founder and CEO Jensen Huang has stepped down following disclosures of extramarital relationships, including one with a woman suspected of being a Chinese spy. CFO Colette Kress takes over as interim CEO while the board seeks a permanent successor.

slides.scene: A high-stakes diplomatic delegation standing inside a gilded Kremlin negotiation hall with Russian and American flags in the background
slides.headline: US envoys meet Putin in Moscow for talks
slides.body: US mediators Jared Kushner and Steve Witkoff met Russian President Vladimir Putin in Moscow following negotiations in Abu Dhabi. Moscow agreed to include European negotiators in the next round of Ukraine peace discussions, per BBC.

slides.scene: Emergency responders searching through the concrete rubble of a damaged multi-story hospital building illuminated by spotlight beams at night
slides.headline: Israeli missile strike hits Gaza hospital
slides.body: An Israeli airstrike hit the surgical and intensive care wards of Nasser Hospital in Khan Younis, killing at least six people and injuring twenty others. The strike badly damaged the largest medical facility remaining in southern Gaza.

slides.scene: Aid workers wearing protective suits surrounding a rural medical clinic near tropical forest under heavy mist
slides.headline: Millions missing from Congo Ebola response
slides.body: Doctors Without Borders warned that millions of dollars meant for Ebola relief in the Democratic Republic of Congo have gone missing, per BBC. Medical staff face unpaid wages and critical supply shortages as the virus continues to spread.
